items.title: ARC-070/MECH-321 policy_decomposition discriminative (ARM_0 OFF vs ARM_1 V_s-drop ON): execution-time forward-PE + deliberation cost
items.note: FIRST behavioural (evidence) experiment of the ARC-070/MECH-321 policy_decomposition lineage: the ARM_0(OFF) vs ARM_1(V_s-drop ON) discriminative pair from MECH-321's functional_restatement, succeeding V3-EXQ-815's readiness diagnostic. ARM_1 uses the R1 trigger (region V_s < threshold OR MECH-288 boundary fires) -- the ONLY trigger the substrate implements. Load-bearing DV: per-seed PAIRED (same env) delta in mean EXECUTION-TIME forward-prediction error (e3_prediction_error, from agent.update_residue -- the committed trajectory's E2 first-step z_world prediction vs observed) over LOW-V_s measurement steps; supports the claim iff ARM_1 reduces it by >=5% relative AND clears a 2-sigma effect-size gate on the SD of the paired delta. Secondary (non-load-bearing) corroborator: rollout deliberation cost (candidate_samples_collected per e3-tick), predicted higher locally in ARM_1. Full waking loop WITH update_residue so world_forward trains (815 omitted it); 40 warmup + 20 measure episodes x 5 seeds x 2 arms. ARM_2 DEFERRED -- NOT BUILDABLE: the substrate (policy_decomposition.py evaluate()) has ONLY the R1 trigger; ARM_2's bottleneck-state PRIMARY trigger (R5) is unimplemented and flagged OPTIONAL/deferred in the functional_restatement itself. /implement-substrate chip spawned 2026-07-25 to build it; a successor experiment adds ARM_2 once it lands and REUSES this run's ARM_0 (minted reuse-eligible via experiments/_lib/baselines/mech321_policy_decomposition.py, include_driver_script_in_hash=False; cite this run_id as reuse_baseline_from). READINESS (P0) self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue (non_degenerate=false, scoring-excluded) rather than a falsification if V_s never drops below threshold, decomposition never fires, or OFF-arm forward PE is constant/unbounded (untrained world_forward). NON-DEGENERACY guards the DV-symmetry trap: requires ARM_0 and ARM_1 executed action sequences to actually DIFFER on >=1 seed (decomposing a chunk into its own raw actions is an identity unless the committed trajectory changes); if inert, manipulation_inert + scoring-excluded, not scored as weakens. ARM_1==ARM_0 with readiness met = weakens (falsifies the primary V_s-drop trigger, per functional_restatement). GOV-REUSE-1: use_policy_decomposition + the cross-arm learning-loop forward-PE contrast did not exist before 2026-07-24; 815 (only prior run) recorded firing counts on a non-learning loop -- not recoverable, run. Re-derive brake: 0 braking autopsies for both ARC-070 and MECH-321 (new claims). MACHINE any/cloud so the ARM_0 mint is cloud-class-reusable (linux-x86_64). Both claims stay v3_pending until this run's evidence is reviewed. Smoke PASS (dry-run: 4 cells end-to-end, P0 gate + arm-fingerprint hoist + recording-core all exercised; dry FAIL is structural -- 2 measure-episodes give <MIN_LOW_VS_STEPS).

items.title: SD-080 consequence-grounding CAPABILITY falsifier (3-arm: ARM_0 frozen / ARM_1 grounded / ARM_2 shuffled-target control)
items.note: Falsifier from action_object_invariance_spike_2026-07-22.md Sec 4.2. Tests the CAPABILITY question orthogonal to V3-EXQ-809's CORRECTNESS finding: 809 showed E2.action_object_head content reaches the hippocampal CEM but washes out behaviourally (O's frozen-random content is NOT behaviourally load-bearing), confirming SD-080. This asks the untested question -- would GROUNDING O in world-effects improve planning? 3 arms x 5 matched seeds, CausalGridWorldV2 size=6, alpha_world=0.9, world/self_dim=32, EXQ-003-comparable behavioural DVs. All arms share ONE P0 substrate per seed (trained once, deepcopied) so the ONLY difference is the P1 head treatment. ARM_0 baseline: P0 only, action_object_head frozen. ARM_1: P0 + P1 trains action_object_head (+ a linear readout) so o_t predicts the realised world-effect (z_world_{t+1}-z_world_t) from (z_world_t,a_t), encoder FROZEN, on .detach()ed latents (phased P1). ARM_2 parameter control: identical P1 but the world-effect target is SHUFFLED across the batch -- same added params + gradient traffic, no consequence structure (without it an ARM_1 win confounds with 'more trained parameters'). PRIMARY GATE (substrate-side, must fire first), ARM_1 ONLY: r2_explained_by_action_alone (M5,ao) falls to <=0.95 (baseline ~0.994) AND mean_within_pair_spearman (M6,ao) rises to >=0.15 (baseline ~0). M5/M6 are the SPIKE PROBE's own measures, vendored verbatim, so the gate needs no new instrument. If ARM_1 does not move both, the grounding objective failed -> self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue with non_degenerate=false (scoring-excluded), NOT a falsification. LOAD-BEARING behavioural verdict (only interpreted if the gate fires): harm_rate + survival under TERRAIN planning (hippocampal.propose_trajectories CEM in O -- the DVs SD-004's EXQ-003/EXQ-114 PASS rests on). Both directions pre-declared: (a) DEFECT LOAD-BEARING -> PASS: ARM_1 beats ARM_0 AND ARM_2 by a 15% relative harm-rate margin with survival not worse and consistent across >=80% of seeds (SD-080 promotes, SD-004 mechanism repaired; SD-080 supports / SD-004 mixed); (b) REAL BUT NOT LOAD-BEARING -> FAIL (informative, not a null): ARM_1 moves the substrate DVs but not behaviour (SD-004's semantic-grounding efficiency rationale demoted -- EXQ-003's 6x survival was terrain/residue navigation, not O's content; SD-080 mixed / SD-004 weakens). DV-SYMMETRY (per arm): DV=harm_rate/survival under the TERRAIN CEM; manipulation = action_object_head content, which enters o_t NON-uniformly across (state,action) -- not a broadcast constant (invisible to argmax/softmax), not a monotone rescaling (rank-preserving), not a permutation; so the DV is NOT invariant under the manipulation for any arm, and a null ARM_1-vs-ARM_0 is a MEASURED null (reading b), not an identity. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readouts are M5/M6 on a GROUNDED head + harm/survival across frozen/grounded/shuffled arms; SD-080 established the head is NEVER trained in ANY recorded run, so a grounded-head readout exists in no manifest and requires this new manipulation -- not recoverable, run. Re-derive brake: SD-080 is a new claim (registered 2026-07-22), 0 braking autopsies; new EXQ number testing a different (capability) question than 809's correctness read -- not braked. MACHINE any/cloud (linux-x86_64): M5/M6 are RNG-free forward-pass linear algebra and behavioural DVs are aggregates, so cross-machine-class multinomial divergence does not bear on the verdict. Behaviour is computed + recorded for ALL cells even under a gate-fail (generous recording). Coordinated with session dazzling-taussig-f58f4c (registered SD-080 + SD-004 cross-ref). Smoke PASS (dry-run: 3 cells end-to-end -- P0 warmup + CEM, P1 head training head_delta~1.0 loss 0.026->0.009, substrate + behavioural DVs, arm-fingerprint hoist + recording-core; dry outcome substrate_not_ready_requeue is structural: 20 grounding steps do not converge the head).

items.title: SD-049 ARM_2 curriculum/density repower (guard_pass load-bearing on joint arm)
items.note: Repowers V3-EXQ-793 (same 2x2 curriculum x density design, same ARM_2 substrate) per the confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-793_2026-07-24.{md,json}: 793 arm-level d3_clears (mean contact_rate) passed clean on A10/A01/A11 at n=3, but per-seed guard_pass showed real fragility not surfaced by the load-bearing criteria -- A11 (joint) failed guard_pass on 2/3 seeds, A01/A10 each on 1/3 -- thin, not decisive. This run: (1) repowers all four arms uniformly from n=3 to n=6 seeds (42-47; 45-47 new, added to rather than replacing 793's 42/43/44) so seeds x conditions matches the actual verdict count and the runner ETA denominator is exact; (2) adds a NEW load-bearing criterion C_JOINT_ROBUST = A11 d3_clears AND guard_pass_frac(A11) >= MIN_FRACTION (2/3, reused not invented), replacing plain C_JOINT (retained as informational) as the outcome gate, per the autopsy repair-pathway recommendation to make guard_pass load-bearing for the joint arm specifically. guard_pass_frac is now reported per arm (informational for A00/A10/A01) so the 1/3 A01/A10 signature stays visible without gating on it (out of this repowering's scope per the task). A new self-route label joint_arm_clears_but_fragile_guard_pass_below_floor distinguishes 'A11 clears on contact_rate but guard_pass stays below floor at n=6' (itself a decisive finding) from a full unrescued/ceiling reading. GOV-REUSE-1: the repowered guard_pass-fraction readout does not exist in any recorded manifest (793 is the only prior run, at n=3) -- not recoverable, run. Arm-fingerprint reuse of 793's own cells was considered and explicitly NOT wired up: 793 ran on ree-cloud-2 (torch2.12.0+cpu) and several substrate-touching changes have landed on main since its 2026-07-21 run (SD-081, ARC-071, MECH-048, SD-076) that near-certainly bust that fingerprint -- the expected near-zero reuse hit rate did not justify the added complexity on a lower-priority follow-up. Re-derive brake: blanket SD-049 count is 4 (514l/538a/693/693a), but ALL FOUR test the DIFFERENT, still-unaddressed foraging-competence/WL-dissociation Phase-2 prerequisite (V3-EXQ-514 full validation), not the D3-gate curriculum/density lever-sufficiency question 793/793a test -- exempted per the skill's own carve-out for a diagnostic discriminating why a ceiling holds; 793's own re_derive_brake block independently reached the same release and named this exact repowering as the legitimate follow-up. SCOPE: this does NOT touch or lift SD-049's actual park (substrate_ceiling, gated on the foraging-competent-policy prerequisite for V3-EXQ-514, which this diagnostic neither tests nor addresses) -- informative curriculum/environment-design context only. Lower priority / optional per user instruction. episodes_per_run 340 is the AMENDED-arm length (793 convention); base arms (A00/A01) run 250, so runner ETA overestimates the base cells. Smoke PASS (dry-run, 4 cells, all progress instrumentation and the new C_JOINT_ROBUST/guard_pass_frac logic paths exercised without error).
